# CEC2013 Vendor Source

This directory vendors the Python implementation from:

- Repository: https://github.com/mikeagn/CEC2013
- Copied subdirectory: `python3/`
- License: Simplified BSD, see `LICENSE.txt`

The wrapper in `src/rlmmo/benchmarks/cec2013.py` keeps this third-party code isolated and handles its relative `data/` path requirement.
